mapper.select: SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, MODIFY_DATE, MODIFY_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, CANCEL_DATE, USE_BIT, PRODUCT_BIT, FROM_REPAIR_AGENT, FROM_REPAIR_CLIENT, TO_REPAIR_AGENT, TO_REPAIR_CLIENT, ORDER_NO, ORDER_DATE, ORDER_COST, BUY_COST, STATE_TYPE, SUMMARY, TRADE_TYPE, ITEM_UNIT, MEMO FROM TR_ORDER WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND USE_BIT = 'Y' ORDER BY SERIAL_NUMBER DESC

SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, MODIFY_DATE, MODIFY_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, CANCEL_DATE, USE_BIT, PRODUCT_BIT, FROM_REPAIR_AGENT, FROM_REPAIR_CLIENT, TO_REPAIR_AGENT, TO_REPAIR_CLIENT, ORDER_NO, ORDER_DATE, ORDER_COST, BUY_COST, STATE_TYPE, SUMMARY, TRADE_TYPE, ITEM_UNIT, MEMO FROM TR_ORDER WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TR_ORDER ( REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, USE_BIT, PRODUCT_BIT, FROM_REPAIR_AGENT, FROM_REPAIR_CLIENT, TO_REPAIR_AGENT, TO_REPAIR_CLIENT, ORDER_NO, ORDER_DATE, ORDER_COST, BUY_COST, STATE_TYPE, SUMMARY, TRADE_TYPE, ITEM_UNIT, MEMO ) VALUES ( NOW(), #{registIp}, 'N', '00', #{useBit}, #{productBit}, #{fromRepairAgent}, #{fromRepairClient}, #{toRepairAgent}, #{toRepairClient}, #{orderNo}, NOW(), #{orderCost}, #{buyCost}, '10', #{summary}, #{tradeType}, #{itemUnit}, #{memo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TR_ORDER SET CANCEL_BIT = 'Y', CANCEL_DATE = NOW() WHERE SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
